{{nihongo|'''Yasaka Shrine'''|八坂神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Gika, Minakuchi-chō, {{ill|Kōka, Shiga|Q847584|qid=Q847584}}, {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|Q131358|qid=Q131358}}. {{nihongo|'''Yasaka Shrine'''|八坂神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

== History ==
According to shrine tradition, Kawakare deity, ancestral deity of local development, was invited here. In {{ill|794|ab|794|af|794|als|794|am|794 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|794|ar|794|ary|794|ast|794|az|794|azb|۷۹۴ (میلادی)|bcl|794|be|794|be_x_old|794|bg|794|bn|৭৯৪|bpy|মারি ৭৯৪|br|794|bs|794.|ca|794|cdo|794 nièng|ceb|794|ckb|٧٩٤|crh|794|cs|794|cv|794|cy|794|da|794|de|794|el|794|eml|794|eo|794|es|794|et|794|eu|794|fa|۷۹۴ (میلادی)|fi|794|fo|794|fr|794|fy|794|ga|794|gan|794年|gd|794|gl|794|he|794|hi|794|hr|794.|ht|794 (almanak jilyen)|hu|794|hy|794|id|794|io|794|is|794|it|794|ja|794年|jv|794|ka|794|kaa|794|kk|794 жыл|ko|794년|la|794|lb|794|lij|794|lmo|794|lt|794 m.|lv|794. gads|map_bms|794|mdf|794|mg|794|mhr|794|mk|794|mr|इ.स. ७९४|mrj|794 и|ms|794|mzn|۷۹۴|nah|794|nap|794|nds|794|new|सन् ७९४|nl|794|nn|794|no|794|nrm|794|nso|794|oc|794|or|୭୯୪|os|794-æм аз|pl|794|pnb|794|pt|794|qu|794|ro|794|ru|794 год|rue|794|sa|७९४|scn|794|sd|794ع|sh|794.|shn|794|si|794|simple|794|sk|794|sl|794|sq|794|sr|794|su|794|sv|794|sw|794|tg|Соли 794|th|พ.ศ. 1337|tk|794|tl|794|tly|794|tr|794|tt|794 ел|uk|794|ur|794ء|uz|794|vec|794|vi|794|war|794|wuu|794年|xmf|794|zh|794年|zh_min_nan|794 nî|zh_yue|794年|qid=Q30887}} (approximately {{ill|Tenpyō|Q1199879|qid=Q1199879}} 21), when Left Minister {{ill|Tachibana no Moroe|fa|تاچیبانا نو موروئه|ff|Tachibana no Moroe|fr|Tachibana no Moroe|ja|橘諸兄|pl|Tachibana no Moroe|pt|Tachibana no Moroe|sh|Tachibana no Moroe|uk|Татібана но Морое|vi|Tachibana no Moroe|zh|橘诸兄|qid=Q3135863}} built temple {{ill|Sangharama|fr|Saṁghārāma|id|Sangharama|ja|伽藍|ko|가람 (불교)|no|Sangharama|pnb|سنگرام|ru|Гаран|sa|सङ्घरामः|vi|Sangharama|zh|伽藍|qid=Q3482038}} at neighboring {{ill|Senkō-ji Temple (Koka, Shiga)|ja|千光寺 (甲賀市)|qid=Q72184313|lt=Senkō-ji}}, shrine buildings were built to protect Buddhist law<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|和書|title=Shrine introduction > Yasaka Shrine (Yasaka) ~ (Saga Ōmiya)|url=http://www.shiga-jinjacho.jp/ycBBS/Board.cgi/02_jinja_db/db/ycDB_02jinja-pc-detail.html?mode:view=1&view:oid=556|accessdate=2019-09-30|publisher=Shiga Prefectural Shrine Association}}</ref>.

In {{ill|932|Q23656|qid=Q23656}} ({{ill|Jōhei|de|Jōhei|fa|جوهی|fr|Ère Jōhei|ia|Johei|id|Jōhei|ja|承平 (日本)|ko|조헤이|ru|Дзёхэй|simple|Jōhei|sr|Џохеи|tr|Jōhei|uk|Дзьохей (ненґо)|zh|承平 (日本)|zh_yue|承平|qid=Q1324874|lt=Jōhei}} 2), for distribution of divine virtue, it received the title Giga Ōmiya and shrine buildings were erected at the current site<ref name=":0" />.

The honden was built in {{ill|1439|Q6380|qid=Q6380}} ({{ill|Eikyō|Q1193059|qid=Q1193059}} 11)<ref name=":0" />. According to Giga Ōmiya Senkō-ji records, the honden was rebuilt in {{ill|1587|Q6744|qid=Q6744}} ({{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|Q1145058|qid=Q1145058}} 15), matching architectural style and methods.

After repairs in {{ill|1721|Q6913|qid=Q6913}} ({{ill|Kyōhō|de|Kyōhō|es|Kyōhō|fa|کیوهو|fr|Ère Kyōhō|ja|享保|ko|교호|ru|Кёхо|simple|Kyōhō|sr|Кјохо|sv|Kyōhō|tr|Kyōhō|zh|享保|qid=Q1145048}} 6) and In the {{ill|Heian period|Q193292|qid=Q193292}} it was called Kawakare Shrine, later Gika Ōmiya, then Gozu Tennō Shrine, and now Yasaka Shrine<ref name=":1">{{Cite book|title=Kōka City History Vol.8 Kōka City Encyclopedia|date=2016-12-12|year=2016|publisher=Kōka City|page=49}}</ref>.

{{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|Q272993|qid=Q272993|lt=Susanoo-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Emperor Shōmu|Q349263|qid=Q349263}}, {{ill|Emperor Jimmu|Q200188|qid=Q200188}}<ref name=":0" />

* Kawakare Festival - {{ill|May 1|Q2544|qid=Q2544}}<ref name=":0" />
** Day before - first-age yakudoshi men carry lion head and visit all parishioner households
** Day of festival - rites in morning; from afternoon mikoshi procession (60 youths in Genroku-style costumes cross the Yasu River)

== Precinct shrines ==

* Tenjin Shrine
* Kumano Shrine
* Kawakare Shrine
* Hachiman Shrine
* Yasaka Shrine

== Cultural properties ==

== Important Cultural Property (National designation) ==

* Honden - ikken-sha nagare-zukuri, cypress-bark roof<ref name=":1" />

== City designated cultural properties ==

* Sacred images - made in Heian period<ref name=":1" />
*Gebabashi bridge - offered by parishioners in 1699 (Genroku 12) in thanks for successful rain prayer. Elaborate arched bridge.
